title: Dinis: an SG/Send access token for crm-silvio (Silvio's CRM agent), one token per agent
detail: Silvio asks (7 November). crm@web-summit.silvio has the private CRM's key (sealed to it 7 November, 02:34) but no SG/Send access token of its own, so it cannot push to the CRM vaults. By the rule in content/vault-agent.md: Dinis issues one token per agent, and the conductor (or Dinis's conductor) seals it to the agent's key crm-silvio (data/keys.json) in data/sealed/agents/crm@web-summit.silvio/. Never in a chat or a commit.
